name: GLM 5.3 Flash

page_notice.markdown: GLM 5.3 Flash is Z.AI's multimodal coding and agentic model for software engineering, sustained agent workflows, and complex reasoning. It accepts text, image, and video inputs, supports tool calling and structured outputs, and provides a 1M-token context window with mandatory low, high, and max reasoning effort levels.

sources.notes: Official GLM-5.3-Flash announcement and model specification.
Official model card lists 320B total parameters, 18B active parameters, and the MIT license.
Published Ox Alpha context, modality, and output-limit metadata used for this model record.

verification.notes: Verified against Z.AI's official GLM-5.3-Flash announcement and Hugging Face model cards.
